name: tou_away_heat_bank_home_return_1404
description: Issue #1404 review: an Away pre-heat bank (63 F) is cut short when the owner comes home at 15:40; the home bank takes over and ends on time at 16:15.

assertions.reason: Home at 15:40 inside the Away pre-heat: the comfort band (heat 68 F) at once, then the 5-minute bank check opens the home bank (heat 76 F) at 15:44:59. Two writes five minutes apart, triggered by the occupancy change (accepted: outside #1393's one-write-per-cycle scope).
Nothing between the home bank opening and the period start.
At 16:15 the home bank ends on time (#1405: the home bank-end timer armed from the bank check, not a cycle) and the band is written.
After the bank no surface claims one.

verdict.summary: Coming home mid-bank switches to the home bank, which ends at the high-cost period's start
verdict.observed_behavior: Issue #1404 review: an Away pre-heat bank (63 F) is cut short when the owner comes home at 15:40; the home bank takes over and ends on time at 16:15.
verdict.expected_behavior: Occupant view: the thermostat and every surface follow the occupancy change mid-bank.
verdict.effectiveness: Fails on 6ebdb16: no write at 16:15 (the home bank kept 76 F until the next cycle). Deleting the home bank-end timer fails the 16:15 row.
verdict.user_outcome: If this regressed, a person who came home during an Away pre-heat would have the furnace heating to 76 F well into the expensive period.
